newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.4 bln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.4 bln for Tuesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $1.4 billion in 42 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $904 million in 12 sales, with a $261 million Puerto Rico Municipal Finance Agency deal through Morgan Stanley & Co. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 30 sales totaling $485 million are on the schedule. A $307 million Georgia deal is the largest.
An additional 15 sales totaling $247 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
